s: Dine shabbat hatteluyim bedibbur ubo l"ch seipim: "vedabber dabar", dareshu chakamim shello yehe dibbureka shel shabbat kedibbureka shel chol, shello yomar dabar peloni eeseh lemachar, vaapillu dabar sheeno asur laasoto beshabbat atzmah ella middibre soperim, kegon sekirut umiqqach umimkar vekayyotze bahem, veap al pi sheen dibbur zeh shebbeshabbat moil lo kelum laasiyya sheyyaaseh lemachar. Veeno domeh leomer lachabero sheyyaaseh lo lemachar, sheamira zo moelet laasiyya shellemachar, sheal yede amira zo oseh chabero lemachar, venimtza shehu motze chapatzayv beshabbat al yede amira zo sheomer lachabero, veasur mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka" ("vedabber dabar"). Mah sheen ken kesheomer al atzmo sheyyaaseh dabar peloni lemachar — en leesor mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka", sheeno motze chapatzayv al yede amira zo, sheap im lo haya omer ken beshabbat haya yakol laasot ken lemachar — ap al pi ken asur mishshum "vedabber dabar", shello yehe dibburo beshabbat kedibburo bechol. Vaapillu lomar mitzva pelonit eeseh lemachar — asur im hu mitzva sheasur laasotah beshabbat. Velo ameru shecheptze shamayim muttar ledabber bahem beshabbat, ella kesheyyesh tzorek lemitzva bedibbur zeh, abal kan en amirato moelet kelum laasiyya shellemachar:

Vaapillu besichat debarim betelim sheen bahem zeker asiyyat melaka kelal — asur leharbot bahem beshabbat, shello yehe dibbur hashshabbat kedibbur hachol. Ubene adam shessippur shemuot vedibre chiddushim hu oneg lahem — muttarim lesapperam beshabbat kemo bechol. Abal gam bechol en libne tora leharbot besicha zo, mishshum "moshab letzim". Abal mi sheeno mitanneg beribbuy hashshemuot — asur lesapperam beshabbat kede sheyyitanneg bahem chabero:

Asur leakkeb hannokri beshabbat bishbil hachob, abal yakol lomar bechol leshopet "maddua lo ikkabta hannokri beshabbat sheobra", ap al pi shemmebin mittok debarayv sheyyeakkebennu beshabbatot habbaot im yizdammen az lair:
Asur leakkeb nikse reuben beyad shimon beshabbat:
Asur lesapper ezeh dabar shennizkar bo tzaaro, kegon mimmitat ohabo vekayyotze bazeh:

Kol dabar sheasur laasot beshabbat min haddin — asur lomar lenokri apillu mibbeod yom laasoto beshabbat, apillu eno tzarik ledabar zeh ad leachar hashshabbat, kegon sheomer lo qodem hashshabbat liskor lo poalim beshabbat sheyyaasu lo melaka achar hashshabbat. Abal dabar sheeno ella chumra beolma leyisrael atzmo — yakol lomar lenokri beshabbat laasoto:

Kol dabar sheasur lomar lenokri laasoto beshabbat — asur apillu lirmoz lo laasoto. Vehu haddin sheasur lomar lo ezeh tzivvuy laasot dabar hammuttar beinyan sheyyabin mittok kak sheyyaaseh melaka beshabbat, kegon lomar lenokri sheyyeqannach chotmo kede sheyyabin sheyyasir happecham shebberosh hanner, shehare zeh kimtzavvehu lehasir happecham ella shehu beremez. Vaapillu im hannokri ba meatzmo lehasir happecham belo remizat hayyisrael — tzarik limchot beyado im oseh bishbil hayyisrael, kevan shehanner hu shel hayyisrael, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"v. Abal muttar lomar lenokri ezeh tzivvuy sheyyabin mimmennu laasot melaka achar hashshabbat, o lirmoz lo melaka laasotah achar hashshabbat, shello neesar ella dibbur bilbad, shenneemar "vedabber dabar". Veim eno omer lo shum tzivvuy, ella sheomer lepanayv ezeh dabar shemmebin mimmennu laasot melaka beshabbat — hare zeh muttar, kegon nokri shehebi iggeret chatuma o qeshura, sheen hayyisrael yakol lepotchah uleqorah — yakol lomar lehannokri "eni yakol liqrotah kol zeman sheenah petucha", vehannokri potechah meatzmo, shehare eno omer lo shum tzivvuy apillu beremez, ella shehannokri mebin meatzmo shetztzarik laasot ken (uledaat atzmo hu oseh lehashlim peullato bishlichut iggeret zo, ulekak en tzarik limchot beyado):

Muttar lomar lenokri achar hashshabbat "maddua lo asita dabar peloni beshabbat sheobra", ap al pi shemmebin mittok debarayv shertzono sheyyaasennu beshabbat habbaa — en bekak kelum, kevan sheomer lo ken bechol, veen baamirato zo shum (remez) tzivvuy laasotah beshabbat habbaa, ella shehannokri mebin ken meatzmo. (Vehu sheasiyyat melaka zo hi beinyan sheen tzarik limchot kesheroeh et hannokri oseh otah beshabbat, kegon sheen hammelaka naaset bachapatzim shel yisrael, vehannokri (eno) sekiro shel yisrael, ella ragil laasot lo betobat hanaa, ayyen simman rm"d veran"b):

Bemaqom sheyyom hashshuq hu beshabbat — asur litten maot lenokri meereb shabbat sheyyiqneh lo chepetz peloni, im oto chepetz eno matzuy liqnot beoto maqom ella beyom hashshuq kemo shehu ragil baayarot qetannot, shehare zeh keillu amar lo beperush liqnot beshabbat shehu yom hashshuq. (Abal bed' veHashem muttar litten lo maot, mittaam shennitbaer besimman rn"b). Veim matzuy qetzat liqnot gam bishar yamim — muttar litten lo maot apillu beereb shabbat, ubilbad shello yomar lo qeneh beshabbat, vegam lo yomar lo shehu holek badderek bemotzae shabbat miyyad veyitztarek hannokri liqnoto beshabbat, shehare zeh keomer lo beperush liqnot beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b. Veken haddin leinyan kol debarim ellu benoten kelim lenokri limkor. Vetob shello ladur kelal beir sheyyom hashshuq hu beshabbat, ki i epshar shello yecheta. Veim hashshuq eno bishkunat hayyehudim — en lachush:

Muttar lomar lenokri beereb shabbat "helak maot behalvaa uqeneh bahem leatzmeka chepetz peloni lemachar beyom hashshuq, vaani echezor veeqqachennu mimmeka achar hashshabbat bepereon chob maot ellu veetten leka revach":

Mi shessakar lo nokri beqabbelanut leholik sechorato lemaqom peloni, uba hannokri velaqach hassechora mibbet yisrael beshabbat, ap al pi sheen kan issur ella mippene marit haayin kemo shennitbaer besimman rm"v — rauy leqonso bemamon lepi oshro, o bemalqut kepi reot ene bet din im en lo mamon. Veim taa shessabar shemmuttar — en qonesin oto, veneeman lomar sheasa beshogeg. Veim laqach hassechora mibbeto mibbeod yom ap al pi shemmaplig min hair beshabbat — muttar, kemo shennitbaer sham:

Dabar sheeno melaka veeno asur laasoto beshabbat ella mishshum shebut — muttar leyisrael lomar lenokri laasoto beshabbat. Vehu sheyyihyeh sham miqtzat choli, ap al pi sheeno kolel et kol haggup velo sakkanat eber. O letzorek mitzva — omer yisrael lenokri laalot bailan berosh hashshana kede lehabi mishsham shopar litqoa bo. O lomar lo sheyyabi lo chammin beshabbat mechatzer lechatzer sheen benehem erub (o derek karmelit, ayyen bemah sheyyitbaer simman shk"h), kede leharchitz bahem hammitztaer. Veyesh omerim shehu haddin bimqom hepsed lo gazeru al shebut, kegon letaltel al yede nokri sechora muqtza hannipsedet al yede geshamim (vaapillu lahabiah labbayit derek karmelit im i epshar beinyan acher). Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed gadol (vehu haddin letzorek gadol ap al pi shello shayyak sham hepsed). Vekol zeh bedabar sheoseh oto hannokri beshabbat kederek shehu oseh bechol, abal dabar shemmeshanneh baasiyyato midderek hachol, ap al pi shehu shebut gamur — muttar laasoto apillu al yede yisrael bimqom tzaar, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"ch. Veyesh omerim shehu haddin bimqom hepsed. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed gadol (ayyen simman shl"v):

Asur leadam lachshob cheshbonotayv bepiv beshabbat, gezera shemma yiktob, ben cheshbon heatid lihyot, ben cheshbon sheabar kebar, ella shetztzarik lo adayin leda oto, kegon kak vekak hotzeti al binyan peloni liskar happoalim, vaadayin nishar beyado missekar happoalim shetztzarik leda mah shennatan lahem kede sheyyeda mah shemmaggia lahem adayin, vaapillu im lepi cheshbon lo yaggia lahem kelum, mikkol maqom akshav qodem hacheshbon zeh mistappeq lo shemma maggia lahem kelum — hare zeh cheshbon hatztzarik lo, veyesh ligzor shemma yiktebennu lezikkaron. Abal im yadua lo sheen maggia lahem kelum mimmennu — hare zeh cheshbon sheeno tzarik lo kelal, umuttar lechashshebo beshabbat. Veken kamma seim tebua haya lanu beshana pelonit, kamma dinarim hotzi bechatnut beno, vekayyotze baellu, shehem biklal sicha betela, hamchashsheb otam beshabbat — kimchashsheb otam bechol, ubilbad shello yarbeh bahem, sheasur leharbot besicha betela beshabbat, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Muttar lomar lepoel "hanireh beeneka shettukal laamod immi laereb"? Ap al pi shemmittok kak mebin shetztzarik lo laereb lesokro limlaka, lepi shello neesar ella dibbur meporash, shenneemar "vedabber dabar", dibbur — asur, hirhur, dehaynu mah shemmebin mittok debarayv — hare zeh muttar. Abal lo yomar "heyeh nakon immi laereb", shezzehu kimdabber beperush sherotzeh lesokro:

Lo aseru ledabber bachapatzayv beshabbat, ella bachapatzim haasurim laasotam beshabbat vei epshar lehamtzi tzad hetter baolam laasotam beshabbat, vaapillu en haissur ella middibre soperim, kegon lomar lachabero o lomar al atzmo beshabbat sheyyabi lemachar perot hammuqtzim letok beto, ap al pi shehem hayyom betok hattechum, vaapillu betok hair hamorebet, mikkol maqom tiltul muqtzeh en tzad hetter baolam laasoto beshabbat (keshetztzarik legup hammuqtzeh, ayyen simman ra"v). Abal im yukal lehamtzi tzad hetter laasot beshabbat otah melaka atzmah sherotzeh laasot achar hashshabbat — muttar lomar beshabbat al atzmo o lachabero sheyyaasenna achar hashshabbat (raq sheyyizzaher shello lehazkir lo leshon sekirut, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"v), apillu im akshav en sham oto tzad hetter. Ketzad? Omer adam lachabero "likrak peloni ani holek lemachar, lek immi", mippene sheyyukal lehamtzi tzad hetter beshabbat illu haya sham burganin ap al pi sheakshav en sham burganin. (Mippene sheinyan issur dibbur bachapatzayv hu mah shemmitasseq beshabbat bidbarim haasurim hayyom, velo neesar ella lehitasseq bidbarim sheissuram nitleh begupam, abal debarim sheissuram nitleh bedabar acher veillule oto dabar hayu debarim ellu beatzmam muttarim beshabbat — muttar lehitasseq bahem bedibbur laasotam achar hashshabbat, shehare hu eno mitasseq beoto dabar haggorem lahem haissur, ella beotam debarim shehaya lahem hetter mechamat atzmam illule oto dabar haggorem lahem haissur. Lepikak, gabbe issur chutz lattechum kevan sheyyesh tzad hetter al yede burganin — nimtza sheen haissur behilluk mechamat atzmo, shehare oto hilluk atzmo muttar kesheyyesh burganin, ella haissur behilluk hu mechamat meniat haddiyyurin al hadderek, vehu eno medabber ella sheyyelek badderek velo sheyyelek bimniat haddiyyurin, veken kol kayyotze bazeh[)]. Veen hetter ella belashon zeh: "ani holek, lek immi", abal lo yomar belashon shemmashmao halika beqaron (sheqqorin bilshon ashkenaz pari"n), shehare lezeh en burganin moilim:

Vekol zeh keshemmedabber al atzmo o lachabero laasot achar hashshabbat, abal lomar lenokri laasot beshabbat — asur ap im yukal lehamtzi tzad hetter leyisrael laasoto, kevan sheakshav en sham oto tzad hetter. Abal im yesh sham tzad hetter beemet sheyyukal hayyisrael laasot behetter oto dabar atzmo shehannokri oseh beissur — yesh mattirin lomar lenokri setam belashon sheen muzkar bo beperush sheyyaaseh beissur vehannokri oseh meatzmo beissur, kemo shennitbaer besimman ra"v. Abal im en sham tzad hetter leyisrael laasot oto dabar atzmo shehannokri oseh lo, ap al pi sheyyesh tzad vederek sheyyukal hayyisrael lehaggia leoto dabar shehannokri oseh lo beli sheyyaaseh et hammelaka shehannokri tzarik laasot beoto dabar ad shemmaggia leyisrael, kegon sheomer lenokri lehabi lo mayim lishtot min hannahar ap al pi sheyyukal hayyisrael lelek beatzmo lenahar velishtot sham — en zeh moil kelum lehattir haamira lenokri, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h:

Muttar lomar lachabero "shemor li perotay shebbitchumeka, vaani eshmor leka peroteka shebbitchumi". Veap al pi shehu asur lo lelek velishmor perotayv shebbitchum chabero — en issur baamirato lachabero, kevan shellachabero muttar hu, vegam lo yesh hetter al yede burganin:

Hashshoel dabar mechabero beshabbat — lo yomar lo "halvenay" ella "hashileni", shehammalveh et chabero eno yakol letobo bepachot mishsheloshim yom, mippene shehahalvaa lehotzaa nittena, veen chozeret been, ella porea lo bedabar acher kemotah, veen derek lilvot kede liproa lealtar ella leachar zeman merubbeh, veshiaru chakamim setam halvaa sheloshim yom, veim ken yesh lachush shemma yiktob hammilveh al pinqaso kak vekak hilveti liploni, kede shello yishkach letobo besop sheloshim yom. Abal hammashil et chabero yakol letobo miyyad, shehashsheela hi chozeret been, veim ken en lachush leshikcha, ulekak en chosheshim shemma yabo liktob. Vaapillu im shoel mechabero kadde yayin vekadde shemen, veken haishsha mechabertah kikkarot, sheenan chozerim been, ap al pi ken kevan sheomer lo leshon sheela — hare noten lo reshut sheyyukal litboa mimmennu lealtar kedin hashsheela. Ukeshem sheen lovin beshabbat ella bilshon sheela — kak en porein ella bilshon chazara. Bilshon laaz sheen chilluq ben "halveni" le"hashileni" — lo yomar leshon sheela, ella yomar "ten li", veyakol lesayyem gam ken "veachazir veetten lak":
Bemaqom shennohagim shessetam halvaa yakol letobo lealtar — rashshay lomar "halveni":

Hashshoel mechabero beshabbat veen halla maamino — yakol lehanniach mashkon etzlo, veyannichennu bistam, velo yomar lo "helak mashkon", shezzehu kemaaseh chol. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beshoel mine maakal umashqeh shehem tzorek hashshabbat, laken hittiru lehanniach mashkon kesheen halla maamino, abal shello letzorek hashshabbat — asur lehanniach mashkon kelal (mippene sheddomeh lemaqneh qinyan beshabbat, ayyen simman sh"v):

Shitre hedyotot, dehaynu shitre chobot umiqqach umimkar umashkanot vecheshbonot, vekol kayyotze bahem mechapatzim haasurim laasot beshabbat — asur liqrotam beshabbat mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka". Vaapillu leayyen bahem belo qeria asur. Velo ameru sheddibbur asur hirhur muttar, ella kesheen haddabar nikkar shemmeharher bachapatzim haasurim, abal kan shennikkar lakkol shemmeharher bachapatzim haasurim hakketubim bashshetar — hare zeh biklal issur "mimmetzo cheptzeka", kemo shebbiklal zeh hamtayyel besadehu lirot mah hi tzerika, sheap shehattiyyul bassadeh dabar hammuttar hu mitztzad atzmo, vegam hahirhur betzorke sadehu dabar hammuttar hu, ap al pi ken kevan shennikkar lakkol shemmetayyel sham bishbil kak — asur mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka", kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"v:

Vegazeru al kol ketab, ap al pi sheen bo mechapatzim haasurim shello liqrot bo beshabbat, vaapillu leayyen belo qeria asur, gezera shemma yiqra o yeayyen beshitre hedyotot. Lepikak, mi shezzimmen orechim vehekin lahem mine megadim vekatab biktab meereb shabbat et shemot haorechim shezzimmen shello yishkach leqoram elayv beshabbat, o shekkatab shemot hamminim shehekin lahem — asur liqrot biktab zeh beshabbat. Vaapillu leayyen belo qeria asur. Vaapillu im hashshemot chaquqim battabla o pinqas velo ketubim — asur, shemma yitu lehattir ap beshitre hedyotot, shehattabla upinqas mitchallepim bishtar. Abal im chaquqim bakkotel — muttar liqrotam beshabbat, shechaqiqat hakkotel enah mitchallepet bishtar. Vehu sheyyihyu chaquqim chaqiqa shoqaat, abal im hem boletin — asur apillu leayyen bahem, gezera shemma yimchoq min haorechim, sheyyireh shello hekin lahem kol tzorkam veyitcharet shezzimmen orechim yoter min harauy, veyigrod veyaabir shemotam habboletim min hakkotel, kede shello yiqraem hashshammash, mah sheen ken chaqiqa shoqaat sheenah nocha limchoq, ubetok kak yizkor shehu shabbat velo yimchoq. Vaapillu im chaqiqa habboletet hu gaboah harbeh berosh hakkotel sheeno yakol lehaggia sham limchoq — asur, mippene shello chillequ chakamim bigzeratam ben gaboah lenamuk, kemo shennitbaer besimman ar"h. Veen tzarik lomar sheim katab biktab al rosh hakkotel, sheasur gam mishshum gezera shemma yiqra beshitre hedyotot, shehakketiba shebbakkotel mitchallepet biktiba shebbishtar:

Akshav nahagu shehashshammash qore lasseudda mittok hakketab shekketubim bo shemot hamzummanim lasseudda. Veyesh shellimmed zekut al hamminhag, lepi sheen nohagin kak ella bisuddat mitzva, uletzorek mitzva en ligzor mishshum shemma yiqra beshitre hedyotot, shehare issur haqqeria beshitre hedyotot eno ella mishshum "mimmetzo cheptzeka", veissur "mimmetzo cheptzeka" lo shayyak bidbar mitzva, shecheptze shamayim haasurim beshabbat laasotam — muttar ledabber bam, velo gazeru becheptze shamayim shemma yitu lehattir gam cheptze hedyot, im ken kol shekken sheen ligzor bidbar mitzva bachapatzim hammuttarim shemma yiqra beshitre hedyotot veyaabor al issur "mimmetzo cheptzeka". Veen leesor kan mishshum gezera shemma yimchoq, mippene shezzeh lo shayyak ligzor ella bebaal hasseudda atzmo sheyyesh beyado limchoq veligroa minyan haqqeruim, abal hashshammash en beyado ligroa, veen leesor bo ella mishshum shemma yiqra beshitre hedyotot im enah seuddat mitzva. (Velo aseru chakamim limnot haorechim mittok hakketab ella lebaal habbayit beatzmo, mishshum gezera shemma yimchoq, sheggezera zo gazeru ap bimqom haknasat orechim ap al pi shehi mitzva gedola, velo aseru bachaquqim al hattabla upinqas mishshum gezera shemma yiqra beshitre hedyotot ella beorechim sheenan meir acheret, ella shezzimmen elayv achuzzat mereehu mibbene iro lisuddat mereut sheeno seuddat mitzva, ayyen simman shl"g):

Veken mah shennahagu shehashshammash qore haskamot o charamot mittok hakketab — en leesor mishshum shemma yiqra beshitre hedyotot, mippene shehem tzorke rabbim, vetzorke rabbim dinam kidbar mitzva, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"v. (Veken mah shennohagin lehazkir neshamot mittok hakketab hu kidbar mitzva, shennoderin litzdaqa bead hazkarat nishmatam, ayyen simman sh"v):

Iggerot shel sheelat shalom — asur liqrotan, vaapillu leayyen bahem belo qeria, gezera mishshum shitre hedyotot. (Veen tzarik lomar beiggerot hashsheluchot limtzo chepetz, ap al pi shehu mechapatzim hammuttarim laasotam beshabbat, sheyyesh ligzor bahen mishshum chapatzim haasurim). Veyesh mattirin liqrot iggeret hashshelucha lo sheeno yodea mah katub bah, ki shemma yesh bah dabar shetztzarik lo legupo, veeno domeh leshitre hedyotot, sheen bahem tzorek haggup ella tzorek mamono. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem lehaqel bedibre soperim. Umikkol maqom lo yiqra bah bepiv, ella yeayyen belo qeria, ki yesh mi shemmeqel beiyyun belo qeria ap biktabim haasurim liqrotam ledibre hakkol:

Muttar letaltel haiggeret beshabbat, veen bah mishshum muqtzeh ap im enah reuya beshabbat leiqqar hanaatah, dehaynu liqrotah, kegon sheyyodea sheen bah tzorek haggup sheasur apillu leayyen bah, mikkol maqom reuya hi lahanaa acheret, kegon latzur al pi tzelochito vekayyotze bazeh. Veap im hubea michutz lattechum beshabbat — en bah mishshum muqtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqt"v. Veap zeh shehubea elayv michutz lattechum — muttar lo lehanot mimmenna apillu beiqqar hanaatah, dehaynu liqrotah im eno yodea mah katub bah. Veenah doma lishar dabar habba michutz lattechum sheasur lezeh shehuba bishbilo lehanot mimmennu ad lemotzae shabbat, shehattaam hu mishshum gezera shemma yomar lenokri sheyyabi lo michutz lattechum, abal beiggeret lo shayyak lomar ken, veod sheiggeret zo lo hubea bishbilo kelal, shehare hashsholeach shelachah bishbil atzmo velo bishbil oto sheshshelucha elayv. (Veap im shelachah bishbilo, mikkol maqom nokri hammebiah beshabbat michutz lattechum mitkavven laasot shelichuto shel hashsholeach, velo bishbil mi sheshshelucha elayv. Veeno domeh leyisrael sheshshigger perot lachabero meereb shabbat al yede nokri venitakkeb vehebiam beshabbat, sheasurim lemi shennishtallechu elayv, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqt"v, lepi shekkevan shehannokri yodea sheyyisrael zeh shemmolik elayv hu yokal beshabbat perot hallalu ulekak hu molikem lo, im ken hu mitkavven bahabaato michutz lattechum bishbil hanaat gupo shel zeh, umittaam zeh ap im hannokri mitkavven letobat atzmo leqabbel sekaro — asur, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman tqt"v. Mah sheen ken beiggeret, sheen gupo shel zeh shehi shelucha elayv neheneh beshabbat miggup haiggeret, veen hannokri mitkavven bahabaato michutz lattechum ella lemallot retzon hayyisrael hashsholecho, o bishbil tobat atzmo leqabbel sekaro, velo bishbil zeh sheshshelucha elayv):

Nahagu shello leqabbel haiggeret miyyad hannokri hammebiah beshabbat, ella omerim lo sheyyannichenna al gabbe qarqa o al gabbe hashshulchan, ki chosheshin shemma terem sheyyaamod hannokri lapush yittol hayyisrael haiggeret miyyado, venimtza shehayyisrael asa hannacha, veasur middibre soperim ap bizman hazzeh sheyyesh omerim sheen lanu reshut harabbim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h:

Kol ketab sheasur leayyen bo beshabbat im hu chashub beenayv umaqpid lehishtammesh latzur al pi tzelochito vekayyotze bazeh — asur letaltelo, shehare eno rauy liklum beshabbat. Lepikak, yesh oserim letaltel get kasher haomed legaresh bo, kemo sheyyitbaer beeben haezer simman ql"v, ayyen sham. Abal get pasul, o get shekkebar geresh bo et haishsha — muttar letaltelo, shehare en maqpidim alayv latzur al pi tzelochito:

Kotel o vilon sheyyesh bo tzurot chayyot meshunnot o deyoqenaot shel bene adam mimmaasim shehayu, kegon milchemet david vegolyat, vekatub tachtehem zo tzurat chayya pelonit vezeh deyoqan peloni — asur liqrot ketab zeh beshabbat, gezera shemma yiqra beshitre hedyotot. Vaapillu leayyen bahem belo qeria asur:

Veken sipre milchamot (vedibre hayyamim shel malke ummot haolam), veken melitzot umeshalim shel sichat chullin, kegon seper immanuel, veen tzarik lomar dibre chesheq — asur liqrotan beshabbat, vaapillu leayyen bahem belo qeria, gezera mishshum shitre hedyotot. Veap bechol asur mishshum "moshab letzim" ap im ketubim bilshon haqqodesh. Ubedibre chesheq yesh od issur apillu ketubim bilshon haqqodesh, shemmegareh yetzer hara beatzmo. Umi shechibberan, umi shehetiqan, veen tzarik lomar hammadpisan — hem biklal machatie harabbim. Abal otan sipre dibre hayyamim sheyyotze mehem inyene musar veyirat shamayim, kegon seper yosipun vekayyotze bo — muttar liqrotam apillu beshabbat, apillu ketubim belaaz. (Umikkol maqom en rauy libne adam leharbot bahem):

Yesh omerim sheasur lilmod beshabbat ubeyom tob raq bedibre tora veyirat shamayim, vaapillu besipre chokmot asur, shekkol seper sheen bo serak qedushsheh — yesh ligzor mishshum shitre hedyotot, ulepi zeh apillu letaltelam asur. Veyesh mattirim bekol sipre chokmot vesipre repuot, mippene sheddebar chokma eno mitchallep beshitre hedyotot, veen ligzor al zeh bishbil zeh. Veken nohagin lehaqel. Ulepi sebara zo muttar lehabbit beshabbat bikli shel hachozim bakkokabim (sheqqorin atzterlo"b) ulehappeko uletaltelo, kemo shemmuttar letaltel sipre hachokma lepi sebara zo, demah hepresh ben katub verashum beet barzel beluchot nechoshet lekatub basseper. Veen leesor mishshum shemma yesalleq halluchot veyachaziren vahare zeh keboneh keli, dekevan shedderek luchot ellu lihyot repuyin — en bahen mishshum boneh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"g:

Apillu dabar shemmuttar lishol min hashshed bechol, kegon lehaggid al haggeneba vekayyotze bah, sheyyesh mattirin lishol min hashshed hoil veen hashshed oseh lo maaseh ella shemmaggid lo dabar hannelam mimmennu kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea simman qa"t — asur lishol mimmennu beshabbat, mishshum "vedabber dabar". Ella im ken hu shoel mimmennu dabar letzorek repua, sheaz muttar lishol mimmennu beshabbat bekol inyan shemmuttar bechol, veal derek sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea sham. Veken kol mine lechashim sheyyesh bahem repua — muttar lelochosham beshabbat kemo bechol, veen bahem mishshum "vedabber dabar":

Im bau mayim shotepim umapsidim nekasayv, o shennitroau chabiyyot shel yayin veholek leibbud — muttar liqrot nokri lesham, ap al pi sheyyodea shebbevadday yetaqqen hannokri meatzmo et hahepsed bimlaka gemura. Raq sheyyizzaher shello lomar lo shum remez tzivvuy letaqqen, abal muttar lomar lepanayv "kol hammatztzil hepsed zeh eno mapsid sekar torcho", shekkemo shehittiru bidleqa lomar bipne nokrim "kol hamkabbeh eno mapsid" — kak hittiru bekol hepsed. Veyesh omerim shello hittiru ella bidleqa lebad. Vehammeqel kisbara harishona bekol hepsed merubbeh — lo hipsid:

Yisrael sheamar lenokri laasot lo melaka beshabbat — muttar lehanot bah laereb leachar shehimtin bikde sheyyeaseh, ubilbad shello yihyeh dabar shel parhesya, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shk"h leinyan nokri sheasa meatzmo bishbil hayyisrael (ayyen sham sheyyesh choleqim):

Lo aseru amira lenokri ella laasot bishbil yisrael, abal muttar lomar lo sheyyaaseh melaka letzorek atzmo o letzorek nokri acher. Vaapillu im maggia leyisrael hanaa mizzeh, kegon sheomer lenokri "kabbeh deleqateka", vekavvanato shello taabor haddeleqa mibbet hannokri lebet hayyisrael, vekol kayyotze bazeh. Vaapillu im hannokri oseh hammelaka letzorko bekelim vachapatzim shel hayyisrael — eno tzarik limchot bo kesheroehu. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehannokri oseh ken meatzmo, abal asur leyisrael lomar lo "tol kelim ellu o chepetz zeh vaaseh bo melakteka beshabbat". Vaapillu im hu maqneh lo legamre et hachepetz hazzeh shehammelaka naaset bo, kegon sheomer lo "tol basar zeh ubashshel oto letzorkeka beshabbat", vaapillu en mezonotayv alayv, sheen lo shum revach baamira zo, veadderabba mapsid hu, ap al pi ken kevan sheomer lo laasot melaka beshello — hare zeh nireh kishlucho, ap shehu mitkavven bimlakto lahanaat atzmo:

Nokri shehebi chapatzim shehem muqtzim lebet yisrael lehapqidam etzlo — yakol leholiko lemaqom mutzna shebbebeto sheyyatzniem shamma. Veen issur bezeh bemah sheomer lenokri letaltel hammuqtzeh ad oto maqom, shehare tiltul zeh hu letzorek hannokri, umuttar lomar lenokri "aseh melakteka". Abal im hachapatzim hammuqtzim shehebi hannokri hem shel hayyisrael — eno rashshay lomar lo sheyyetaltelem lehatznio, ella im ken beod shehachapatzim beyad hannokri, shekkeshennokri topes hammuqtzeh beyado — muttar lomar lo letaltelo lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh hayyisrael (lepi sheap yisrael hattopes muqtzeh beyado bezadon o bishgaga — muttar letaltelo beodo beyado lekol maqom sheyyirtzeh, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman sh"ch):

Nokrim hammebiim agalot meleot tebua beshabbat leyisrael shehem chayyabim lo, vehayyisrael noten lahem mapteach otzaro, vehem noseim hattebua laotzar umodedim umonim otam sham bipne hayyisrael — en issur baddabar, shehannokrim bimleket atzman hem oseqim, ki en hattebua shel hayyisrael ad achar sheyyachshob immahem achar hashshabbat, ubeshabbat enah ella kepiqqadon etzlo, vehem modedim umonim et piqdonam. Abal im hebiu tebua shel yisrael — asur lomar lahem lepannotah mehaagalot letok otzaro apillu belo medida uminyan, shehare leyisrael atzmo asur lo lepannotah middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shl"g, vekol dabar sheasur leyisrael laasot beshabbat apillu middibre soperim — asur lomar lenokri laasot bishbilo. (Vaapillu im hem meatzmam baim lepannot letok otzaro — tzarik limchot beyadam, shekkevan shehattebua shello im yireh veyishtoq — ledato hem osim, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"b):

Nokrim haosim gebinot beshabbat mechalab shellahem, vehayyisrael roeh et hachaliba vehaggibbun kede sheyyihyeh muttar leyisrael leoklan veyukal liqnotan achar hashshabbat laakila, ap im hayyisrael omed beeder chodesh o chodshayim vehannokri mitkavven baasiyyatan bishbil lemokran lo bilbaddo velo lenokrim — hare zeh muttar, shemmikkol maqom hannokri oseh letobat atzmo, veen issur kelal bemah shehayyisrael omed alayv bimlakto beshabbat (kevan shehannokri bimleket atzmo hu oseq), sheadayin en shem hayyisrael niqra kelal al haggebinot ad sheyyiqneh otan mimmennu achar hashshabbat. (Ulepikak, muttar lomar lo sheyyaaseh apillu beshabbat, shemmuttar lomar lenokri "aseh melakteka" ap im maggia mizzeh revach leyisrael, kemo shennitbaer leel):
